a.speaker: tommy_burnt
a.text: ...see? You can put a fire out. You just never want to.

c.speaker: tommy_burnt
c.text: No. You're doing it for them. Look up. The little red lights.

d.speaker: tommy_burnt
d.text: Top billing, Cassie. It's all yours. It always was.

k2.speaker: narration
k2.text: The fire goes out. The dead applaud politely, like a studio audience told when to.

s2.speaker: narration
s2.text: She holds him while he burns. It doesn't hurt. That's how she knows it's a dream.

s3.speaker: tommy_burnt
s3.text: Check the credits, Cassie. Check who signed.

c2.speaker: narration
c2.text: Up in the smoke, where the ceiling should be: a row of little red lights. Recording. They always were.
